mechanism: Venlafaxine may increase serotonin-mediated effects on platelet aggregation and vascular tone, while tobramycin carries independent nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risks that could be exacerbated by reduced renal clearance in susceptible patients.
action: Monitor renal function regularly; assess for signs of ototoxicity or nephrotoxicity; ensure adequate hydration; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of tobramycin levels if renal impairment develops.
